title: autoSpaceDE and autoSpaceDN are independent switches; a custom stop inside the hanging area catches the numbering tab
source: corpus 2026-10-13 W3I (FangSong 16pt, compat 14): autoSpaceDE=0 only -> no CJK/letter gap, CJK/digit gap kept; Arial bold 14 heading, level left=720 hanging=720, marker ends ~160 twips, paragraph stops 450/1350/3060 -> text at the 450 stop

cases.note: DE off: only the CJK/digit gap survives
DN off: only the CJK/letter gap survives
the explicit 450 stop between the marker end and the 720 hanging indent catches the tab
no custom stop: the text starts at the hanging indent
